decision_conditions: The proposals would in the absence of any evidence otherwise materially change the character of the site by introducing late night uses of a scale removed from the surrounding environment which would likely materially intensify levels of activity late into the evening, when occupiers of neighbouring sites and surrounding premises may reasonably expect noise levels to be lower. In the absence of surety how the uses would operate it is not possible to conclude that the operations would be suitable and would add to the overall quality of the area, be sympathetic to local character and would not undermine the quality of life or community cohesion and resilience as Para 134 of the Framework requires. There would also be conflict with Local Plan Policies 7, 13, 26 and 34.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to the agent in writing 20-08-2025

The applicant is reminded that REF: P0606.22 required submission of details before any use were to commence. Those matters should be resolved in advance of any use commencing and prior to the variation in any operating hours being sought.
